csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; public class FixLiveSceneLight { public static void Execute() { Scene targetScene = SceneManager.GetSceneByName("Outbreak_Metaverse_Live"); if (!targetScene.IsValid()) return; SceneManager.SetActiveScene(targetScene); bool hasLight = false; foreach (var go in targetScene.GetRootGameObjects()) { var lights = go.GetComponentsInChildren<Light>(true); foreach(var l in lights) { if (l.type == LightType.Directional) hasLight = true; } } if (!hasLight) { GameObject sunGo = new GameObject("Directional Light"); SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(sunGo, targetScene); Light sun = sunGo.AddComponent<Light>(); sun.type = LightType.Directional; sun.shadows = LightShadows.Soft; sun.intensity = 1.2f; sun.color = new Color(1f, 0.95f, 0.9f); sunGo.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50f, -30f, 0f); RenderSettings.sun = sun; Debug.Log("Created Sun in Outbreak_Metaverse_Live."); } Material skyMat = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>("Assets/Materials/ProceduralSky.mat"); RenderSettings.skybox = skyMat; DynamicGI.UpdateEnvironment(); foreach (var go in targetScene.GetRootGameObjects()) { var cams = go.GetComponentsInChildren<Camera>(true); foreach (var cam in cams) { cam.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.Skybox; EditorUtility.SetDirty(cam); } } UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveOpenScenes(); } }
